title: Great experience, one of the highlights of our trip
text:
Hard to choose a favorite part! My friends loved the market tour where Chef Josh took us to a local market frequented by locals (not the big touristy one) where he personally knew the food vendors and gave us fascinating history on not just the local food itself but on the market system in Barcelona as a whole. 

After buying fresh seafood at the market, we took a short walk to his kitchen where we had an amazing afternoon having him walk us through the preparation and steps to making an authentic paella. (I’m not great in the kitchen but even I was able to contribute with his guidance.)

The
author: solipchris

title: Paella - Heaven
text:
We had a great time walking around the market and getting to know the culture of Spanish food shopping. We cooked the paella from scratch and had a great time chatting, cooking and tasting :) We can totally recommend this also for kids, our 11 and 15 year old had a great time and participated in cutting and cooking.

Thanks Eric for a wonderful morning and paella lunch!
author: SusanneS717

title: Best meal of our trip!
text: Our market tour & paella cooking class with Josh was one of the highlights of our time in Barcelona. Josh did a wonderful job teaching us how to make authentic paella & my son declared it the best meal of our trip (I would have to agree!). The tour of the market was informative as well. Oh, and the sangria was the best I’ve had!
author: thespicyrd

title: Cooking with Josh
text:
Great time with Josh and cooked a noodle version of paella which was great fun.  Nice to have a bilingual host who we could understand completely and intro us to a Barcelona market.

Thanks chef josh.
